FK referencing item_master
FK referencing warehouses
FK referencing warehouse_locations
FK referencing lots (NULL for non-lot items)
Physical quantity on hand in base UoM
Quantity allocated to open issues / work orders
on_hand_quantity - reserved_quantity
Current moving average unit cost for valuation
Timestamp of the last posting that touched this row

inventory_ledger.purpose: Append-only stock movement log; every posted receipt, issue, transfer, production, adjustment and waste writes here

columns.purpose: Primary key; unique ledger entry identifier
RECEIPT, ISSUE, TRANSFER_OUT, TRANSFER_IN, PRODUCTION_CONSUME, PRODUCTION_OUTPUT, ADJUSTMENT, WASTE, OPENING_BALANCE
Source document (STOCK_IN, STOCK_OUT, STOCK_TRANSFER, WORK_ORDER_COMPONENT, WORK_ORDER_OUTPUT, STOCK_ADJUSTMENT, STOCK_WASTE)
Header id of the source document
Line id of the source document
Accounting date of the movement
FK referencing item_master
FK referencing warehouses (warehouse affected by the movement)
FK referencing warehouse_locations
FK referencing lots (NULL for non-lot items)
Serial number moved (for is_serial_tracked items)
Signed quantity in base UoM (+ in, - out)
Stocking unit of measure (from item_master)
Valuation cost per unit at posting
ledger_quantity x ledger_unit_cost
Self-referencing FK; set on a reversal entry to point at the entry it cancels
Timestamp the entry was written
User or system process that posted the entry (hr_users)
